Subject: Next steps & artifact checklist — SOC 2, pen test, DPA (TidalBank)

Jacob — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap so we have alignment and a practical set of next steps from the call: 

Key pain points you shared
- External audit coming up in Q4; need to validate vendor controls and retention settings for any hosted LLMs.
- Concerns about tenant-level audit logs (searchability, exportability), and retention policy timelines (30/90/365 days).
- Request for pen test evidence and clarity on scope (app-layer + infra).
- DPA redline items around subprocessors and data residency (US-only requirement).

What Redwood will provide (initial delivery)
- Artifact checklist: SOC 2 (Type II) scope summary, control narrative, and exported evidence where permissible.
- Pen test executive summary + remediation timeline.
- Draft DPA with our standard redlines highlighted for your legal team.
- Answers to 8 immediate technical questions about logs, retention, and encryption (attached).

Attachments in this email: [attachment: SOC2-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet) — list of short technical questions we promised to answer]

Proposed timeline
- By EOD next Tue (2027-06-22): deliver SOC2 summary + answers to spreadsheet questions.
- By Fri next week (2027-06-25): pen test executive summary + draft DPA for redline.
- Schedule procurement/legal sync after you review the DPA (I’ll propose times).

Optional deployment options to reduce scope: we discussed Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) and Private deployment (VPC) if residency/SLA constraints drive procurement decisions. If you want, we can surface cost delta estimates in the next email.

Action items for you
- Confirm which retention buckets (30/90/365) are acceptable vs. must-have.
- Share any additional legal contacts to include on the DPA redline.

Thanks — I’ll loop Rishi into the thread for any deeper security questions.

—

Subject: Re: Next steps & artifact checklist — SOC 2, pen test, DPA (TidalBank)

Thanks Markus — good summary. A couple clarifications from our side after the internal huddle: 

Questions we need answered explicitly
1) Audit logs: can you confirm whether logs are segmented by customer/tenant and whether exports include immutable timestamps and requester identifiers? We need a sample CSV or export format.
2) Retention: our policy requires proof that retention can be set per-customer and enforced (not just application-level). Which retention buckets are configurable?
3) Pen test: we need the full scope (network, infra, application) and dates of the last two tests. If you cannot share full reports, the executive summary and remediation tracker are fine.
4) DPA: our legal team will send a redline. Please flag any clauses that are deal-breakers for Redwood (subprocessors, cross-border transfers).

Timing: the audit team would prefer to have most of the artifacts by the end of next week (2027-06-25). Can you meet that?

Cc’ing procurement so they can start a paperwork checklist.

Jacob Mills
Director, IT & Audit
TidalBank

Appreciate the list — we can meet that timeline. Quick responses inline and attachments included: 

1) Audit logs
- Redwood provides customer-scoped audit events with owner_id and requestor metadata. Exports are CSV/NDJSON and include immutable timestamps. I attached a sanitized sample export and a short doc that describes field definitions.

2) Retention
- Retention is configurable per-customer at the account level. Default templates: 30/90/365 days; we can add a custom SLA if required for Dedicated/Private deployments.

3) Pen test
- Attached: pen_test_summary.pdf (executive summary of last external test, dates, and high-level findings). Full reports are restricted but we can provide an auditor-facing package under NDA if required.

4) DPA
- Attached: dpa_draft_redline.docx with our standard positions annotated. High-level flags: subprocessors list, cross-border subprocessors (we honor US-only residency when requested — see section 4), and standard liability caps. If you circle the clauses you’d like softened, our legal ops will propose language.

Attachments in this message: [attachment: pen_test_summary.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: dpa_draft_redline.docx (word)], [attachment: sample-audit-export.csv (csv)]
